substring_overfire_rows.teaches: the template requires the review's search period to be stated and sets its end between the decision on the analysis framework and the submission, asks for the databases and search expressions used under a PRISMA lead and counts hand-searched unpublished data in the flow chart; it names no searcher and no date of search

the issued guideline sets the literature stage by evidence class, leaves inclusion to the evaluation theme with PICOS optional (可), requires several Chinese and English databases, two independent screeners with a third arbitrating and a flow chart of counts and reasons, asks at 指标 4 whether the search followed Cochrane and other organisations' methods, and asks for the search strategy as a report annex; its text form holds PRISMA, 灰色文献 and 检索日期 0 times each

the chapter gives librarians and information specialists an integral role, lists among their services that the reporting aligns with the current PRISMA and PRISMA-S guidance, and treats finding unpublished studies as important for minimizing bias

the guideline says the evaluation report should state whether the search was restricted, whether it was a hand search and whether grey literature was searched (是否检索灰色文献), and that searchers should collect unpublished material — conference papers, unpublished theses, industry and consultancy reports — because it may hold negative results whose omission biases the evaluation

the NMPA issued the interim guideline by notice on 18 June (dated 2019-06-18 in the byline); it has five parts — 概述, 方法学要点, 报告撰写规范, its reference basis and appendices — and brings in Cochrane's standardized review process and whole-process quality control

the NMPA organized the formulation of the interim guideline, issued on June 18, 2019; the page cites Article 4 of the 2018 No. 66 announcement on direct ADR reporting by marketing authorization holders as the duty the evaluation serves, and says the guideline introduces Cochrane's standardized review process and quality control

date_term_rows_with_contrast.teaches: A last-reviewed date for accuracy is a property separate from publication or modification dates

underfire_property_contrast_rows.teaches: supersedes S024 — lastReviewed records the date a web page was last reviewed for accuracy and/or completeness; no comparison to other date properties claimed
